# Upstream provenance

Source: https://github.com/yardenfren1996/B-LoRA

Commit: `e08380dfd3a5e337f74d76bcc1155bfd2c5c0d3d`

The five upstream files in this directory are copied without content changes:
`train_dreambooth_b-lora_sdxl.py`, `inference.py`, `blora_utils.py`,
`requirements.txt`, and `LICENSE`. SHA-256 checksums are recorded in `source.json`.

These files were added during repository migration. They were not present in
the original local experiment folder. Their presence does not establish which
upstream revision produced the archived checkpoints. GPU execution has not been
validated as part of the migration.

Method: Yarden Frenkel, Yael Vinker, Ariel Shamir, and Daniel Cohen-Or,
“Implicit Style-Content Separation using B-LoRA”, 2024.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14572

Upstream license: MIT; see the adjacent unmodified `LICENSE`.
